source_quote: Microsoft Agent Framework is Microsoft's successor to both Semantic Kernel and AutoGen. AutoGen moved into maintenance mode in 2026. For teams building production AI agents, the serverless platform you choose can materially affect code-execution isolation, elastic scaling, CPU and GPU access, networking, and operational overhead. A purpose-built AI infrastructure platform can simplify how you deploy and manage agent workloads. This guide examines seven serverless platforms that serve different Microsoft Agent Framework deployment needs in 2026, starting with Modal, an AI-native solution that combines isolated Sandboxes, broad compute selection, fast serverless scaling, and code-first infrastructure.

PrismML has released Ternary Bonsai 2 27B , a ternary-weight version of Qwen3.8 27B . The language model occupies 5.93 GB, against 53.80 GB in FP16. PrismML reports that it keeps 98.2% of the parent model’s average across 20 benchmarks. The model accepts text and images and supports a 262K-token context. PrismML demos it driving Cline coding agents and computer use on an RTX 5090. It arrives 2 months after the first Bonsai 27B , whose ternary variant retained about 95%.
Yes. The Apache 2.0 weights run today on a 16 GB laptop or a single 24 GB GPU. You need PrismML’s llama.cpp fork or its MLX runtime.
